actions.code: (() => { const rawPage = Number('{{page}}'); const page = Number.isFinite(rawPage) && rawPage > 0 ? Math.floor(rawPage) : 1; const base = 'https://jiepaiclub.com'; if (page <= 1) return base + '/'; return base + '/page/' + page + '/'; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://jiepaiclub.com'; const out = []; const seen = []; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } return ''; }; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const makeId = (url) => { try { const u = new URL(url); return (u.pathname + u.search).replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+$/, ''); } catch (e) { return url; } }; document.querySelectorAll('article.post').forEach((item) => { if ((item.getAttribute('class') || '').indexOf('whisper') >= 0) return; const linkEl = item.querySelector('.post-title > a[href$=".html"], h2.post-title > a[href$=".html"], h1.post-title > a[href$=".html"]'); if (!linkEl) return; const href = linkEl.getAttribute('href') || ''; const url = abs(href); const id = makeId(url); if (!id || seen.indexOf(id) >= 0) return; const imgEl = item.querySelector('.thumb img, .post-content img'); const coverRaw = attr(imgEl); const cover = coverRaw ? abs(coverRaw) : ''; if (!cover || /\/(logo|gonggao|shipin)\.(webp|svg|png|jpg)$/i.test(cover) || !/\.(webp|jpg|jpeg|png)(\?|#|$)/i.test(cover)) return; const title = clean(linkEl.getAttribute('title') || linkEl.textContent || id); const metas = Array.from(item.querySelectorAll('.post-meta li')).map((el) => clean(el.textContent)).filter(Boolean); const genre = Array.from(item.querySelectorAll('.post-meta a[href*="/tag/"]')).map((el) => clean(el.textContent)).filter(Boolean).join(', '); seen.push(id); out.push({ id, title, cover, url, status: 'completed', author: genre, updateTime: metas.length > 0 ? metas[0] : '', genre }); }); return JSON.stringify(out); })();

(() => { let keyword = String('{{searchKeyword}}' || '').trim(); if (/^\{\{.*\}\}$/.test(keyword)) keyword = String('{{query}}' || '').trim(); if (/^\{\{.*\}\}$/.test(keyword)) keyword = ''; const q = encodeURIComponent(keyword); return 'https://jiepaiclub.com/search/' + q + '/'; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://jiepaiclub.com'; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } return ''; }; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const title = clean(document.querySelector('article.post h1.post-title a')?.textContent || document.querySelector('article.post h1.post-title')?.textContent || document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || document.title).replace(/\s*-\s*街拍团.*$/, ''); let cover = ''; const imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article.post .post-content img')); for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) { const url = abs(attr(imgs[i])); if (url && !/\/(logo|gonggao|shipin)\.(webp|svg|png|jpg)$/i.test(url) && /\.(webp|jpg|jpeg|png)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url)) { cover = url; break; } } const desc = clean(document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')?.getAttribute('content') || ''); const metas = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article.post .post-meta li')).map((el) => clean(el.textContent)).filter(Boolean); const tags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article.post a[href*="/tag/"]')).map((el) => clean(el.textContent)).filter(Boolean); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author: tags.join(', '), status: 'completed', description: desc, genre: tags.join(', '), updateTime: metas.length > 0 ? metas[0] : '' }); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://jiepaiclub.com'; const pages = []; const seen = []; const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } return ''; }; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const push = (v) => { if (!v || /^data:/i.test(v)) return; const url = abs(v); if (/\/(logo|gonggao|shipin)\.(webp|svg|png|jpg)$/i.test(url)) return; if (!/\.(webp|jpg|jpeg|png)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url)) return; if (seen.indexOf(url) >= 0) return; seen.push(url); pages.push({ index: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url }); }; document.querySelectorAll('article.post .post-content img').forEach((img) => push(attr(img))); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
